Chapter 203: Chapter 7: The Robust Eldest Apprentice Brother (Subscribe Please)

Lin Yuan recounted the incident with Heiyu Ao to his eldest senior brother.

“How dare that youngest son of Heiyu Mo?” The eldest senior brother shook his head. Even Heiyu Mo himself had to be respectful in front of him, let alone his youngest son?

“Little junior brother.”

“How do you want to resolve this issue?”

The eldest senior brother asked casually.

For him, the matter was indeed not difficult.

...

Even extremely easy.

The simplest way would be for him to personally contact Heiyu Mo.

To tell him to keep his youngest son in line.

Given the eldest senior brother’s status, a single word would be enough to shake the Heiyu Family,

and it was likely that Heiyu Ao would be captured by his family the next day, perhaps even bound and brought to Chikun Main Star to apologize.

The eldest senior brother understood Heiyu Mo too well, very adept at weighing pros and cons, appraising situations.

Of course.

This method was not without its risks.

That is, it might greatly expose Lin Yuan’s true identity.

If Lin Yuan chose this method, before contacting Heiyu Mo, the eldest senior would suggest that Lin Yuan’s true body go to Chikun Main Star.

“Eldest senior brother, I still want to stay on Canglan Star for a few more years,” Lin Yuan said thoughtfully in a low voice.

Before reaching the sixth rank, Lin Yuan wasn’t keen on going to Chikun Main Star.

There were too many powerful beings there, even under the Chikun Star Lord’s very nose.

Lin Yuan had quite a few secrets.

Such as the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Such as the Martial Arts Evolution System.

Before the sixth rank, an evolver’s soul had not yet fully bonded with a fundamental evolution path, and was prone to having their secrets perceived.

Lin Yuan was not worried about the Door to the Myriad Realms, since even the Virtual World could not replicate it, and he estimated that the Chikun Star Lord would not be able to detect the reality of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

But the Martial Path Evolutionary Path… right now Lin Yuan’s soul was slowly aligning with the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, at a critical moment.

If the powerful beings on Chikun Main Star noticed something, it would be a significant risk.

With the current potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

the exposure of its creator’s identity would be far more severe than if Lin Yuan were to reveal his identity as the Peak Master of the Thirteenth Peak of the Red Kun Lineage.

“Don’t want to leave Canglan Star?”

The eldest senior brother stroked his chin.

This meant that he couldn’t warn the Heiyu Family openly.

“I know what to do now.”

The eldest senior brother nodded and looking at Lin Yuan said, “Don’t worry, little junior brother. Just focus on your cultivation on Canglan Star. That Heiyu Ao will absolutely have no chance to make a move against you.”

“And he will not be detected by those ‘divination’ evolutionary path evolvers, capturing any information regarding little junior brother’s true identity.”

The eldest senior brother’s expression became slightly solemn.

‘Divination’ evolutionary path evolvers, weak individually, wield considerable influence over the grand scheme of things.

In the history of Human Civilization, there have been several top diviners who used the Cosmic Starry Sky as a chessboard, and many Peak Clans as pawns, laying out their plans freely.

It’s just that top-level diviners are too rare, and the top diviners of Human Civilization are all stationed in the Human Central Starfield, light-years away, planning for other clans.

“Then thank you very much, eldest senior brother,” Lin Yuan said earnestly.

For the eldest senior brother to agree to Lin Yuan’s request without hesitation from his lofty position was indeed precious.

Even other Seventh Rank Evolvers may not necessarily get the eldest senior brother to do them a favor.

“Between brothers, what’s there to thank,” the eldest senior brother said nonchalantly, “I’m waiting for you, my little junior brother, to step into the sixth rank and join me for a drink.”

…

At Canglan Star, Central Continent Manor.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, resolute in his heart.

Although he was almost certain that Heiyu Ao would not act rashly,

he also had to consider the most extreme possibility. Getting the assurance from the eldest senior brother, Lin Yuan let out a sigh of relief.

“The sixth rank.”

“As long as I can step into the sixth rank.”

“My soul fully aligned with the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

“Others will not be able to discern which evolution path I am cultivating.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The sixth rank represented a qualitative transformation for Lin Yuan.

This transformation related not only to strength but also to identity.

As long as he stepped into the sixth rank, his ability to protect himself would greatly increase, and he could reveal his identity as the Peak Master of the Thirteenth Peak openly, appearing before everyone in his true form.

No need to hide as he was now.

…

In his personal space,

Heiyu Ao sat on the throne, his face dark.

“Young master.”

The elderly man dressed in a black suit named Bei Zhao appeared, bowing to Heiyu Ao sitting on the throne above.

“That Lin Yuan, he refused me,” Heiyu Ao said, looking down at Bei Zhao.

“He refused even the young master’s personal invitation?” Bei Zhao’s expression was one of astonishment.

A personal invitation from a direct descendant of the Heiyu Family was a great honor. How could Lin Yuan dare to refuse?

“So, young master, what do you plan to do?” The black-suited Bei Zhao inquired tentatively.

“What do I plan to do?”

“What do you think I should do?” Heiyu Ao asked.

“It’s just a genius from a backward middle-grade life planet, his refusal of the young master’s invitation is his own loss. There’s no need for the young master to concern himself with it; just continue to recruit other evolvers,” Bei Zhao tentatively said.

He implied it was better to avoid unnecessary trouble and not waste time on such a person.

“No,”

“He is no ordinary genius,” Heiyu Ao growled.

Lin Yuan was one of the two hundred and twenty-three evolvers singled out by the ‘Think Tank’ of the Heiyu Family.

They had the potential to shine in the Star Domain-level tournament, earning vast wealth for Heiyu Ao,

Such a genius must be controlled by Heiyu Ao himself.

“The young master must have Lin Yuan?” Bei Zhao continued to inquire.

“Yes,” Heiyu Ao nodded.

“It’s not difficult, just somewhat troublesome,” Bei Zhao mused for a moment.

“Speak up,” Heiyu Ao’s spirit rose.

“Since Lin Yuan is unwilling to join the young master’s ranks, then force him to join,” Bei Zhao stated.
